name: What specific details does Discounted Roofing Co. include in their repair consultation reports?

mainEntity.name: What specific details does Discounted Roofing Co. include in their repair consultation reports?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our residential roof repair consultation reports from Discounted Roofing Co. include detailed findings from the inspection, photographic evidence of damage, recommended repair solutions, and a transparent cost estimate. We specifically outline the scope of work, materials to be used, and the projected timeline for repairs. This comprehensive approach ensures you have a clear understanding of your roof's condition and the proposed solution, enabling you to make an informed decision without hidden surprises.
acceptedAnswer.description: Reports include detailed findings, photos of damage, recommended repairs, scope of work, materials, and a transparent cost estimate.
